title: explain format upfront
rule: If a field requires a specific format or type of input, state those instructions before the user fails.
pass_when: Format/type instructions are visible next to the field before submit failure.
fail_when: Format is stated only in a post-submit error, or never.
overview: State format or type instructions before the user fails submit.
apply_when: Fields require a specific format, pattern, or input type.
not_when: Free-text fields with no format or type constraint.
agent_hint: Show format instructions beside the field before any submit error.
description: If a field needs a specific format or type of input, those instructions must be visible next to the field before the user hits a submit failure. Stating format only in a post-submit error, or never, fails. Pass when format/type guidance is readable up front; fail when users learn the rule only after an error or not at all. Keep the copy tied to the constrained field, not buried elsewhere.
